<action>Code_Executor</action>
<action_input>{"code":"import nanosurf, time, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Initialize AFM application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application
scan = app.Scan

# Configure scan size 10 µm x 10 µm
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # meters
scan.Points = 256        # points per line
scan.Lines = 256        # lines per frame
# Center the scan (optional)
scan.CenterPosX = 0.0
scan.CenterPosY = 0.0

# Start the scan (upward direction)
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
while scan.IsScanning:
    print(f"Scanning... line {scan.Currentline}/{scan.Lines}")
    time.sleep(1)
print("Scan completed")

# Retrieve image data (the API provides ImageData as a 2D numpy array)
try:
    data = scan.ImageData
except AttributeError:
    # Fallback: some versions expose the image via app.ImageData
    data = getattr(app, 'ImageData', None)
    if data is None:
        raise RuntimeError('Unable to retrieve image data from AFM API')

# Save the image as PNG
output_path = os.path.abspath('afm_10x10um.png')
plt.figure(figsize=(6,6))
plt.imshow(data, cmap='viridis')
plt.title('AFM Topography 10x10 µm')
plt.axis('off')
plt.savefig(output_path, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Image saved to:', output_path)

# Clean up
del spm
"}
